lesson.complete.msg: That's today's practice done, Marta. Nicely done.
act.intro.prompt: Look, listen and learn these words.

act.pairsay.prompt: Now you say it. Record yourself.
say.title: Say it
say.empty: I didn't catch that — please try again.
practice.immersion.note: See the picture and hear the word. Hungarian is hidden — turn it on any time.

practice.quick.note: A short mixed session — a few words to say and write.

conv.repair.shorter: You can say it in a shorter way.

settings.voice.none: No British voice found. The app will use another voice.

diag.intro: This is not a test. It helps us find a good place to start.
diag.q.audio: Can you hear this word clearly?

help.audio: If you cannot hear the voice, check your speakers and open Settings.
